study: Architecture comparison 2: ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV3-Small vs from-scratch models (validation only)
research_question: Can pretrained visual feature representations applied to Log-Mel spectrograms improve respiratory-sound classification compared with models trained from scratch?

reference_runs.crnn_v1: frozen negative CRNN comparison, val macro-F1 0.4153

experiment: mobilenetv3_pretrained_v1 (exactly one full run; no alternatives based on its result)

model.first_conv_conversion: 1-channel kernel = sum over RGB input channels of the pretrained 3-channel kernel (W_gray = W_R + W_G + W_B); equivalent to feeding the grayscale image replicated to (x, x, x); no ImageNet input normalization (inputs already train-standardized per mel band)
model.classifier: pretrained Linear(576,1024)+Hardswish kept; Dropout(0.3); new Linear(1024,4)
model.padding_awareness: block-wise masked forward; MaskedBatchNorm2d (valid-position batch statistics in training, ImageNet-initialized running statistics updated with momentum 0.01, running statistics at inference); masked squeeze-excitation and masked global average pooling; padded positions zeroed after every layer
model.input: frozen (B,1,64,T) Log-Mel, variable length, no resizing
model.pretrained_tensors_reused_unchanged: 241 of 244 (first conv derived by RGB sum; final layer new)

transfer_protocol.strategy: initialize from ImageNet weights, replace classifier, fine-tune end-to-end (all layers trainable, single learning rate)
transfer_protocol.learning_rate_rationale: conservative end-to-end fine-tuning rate for an ImageNet CNN with Adam-type optimizers (1e-4 is the common default; a lower rate than typical from-scratch training limits destruction of pretrained features). It also equals the frozen baseline's rate, so the comparison isolates architecture/pretraining.

comparison: vs baseline_cnn_v3 and crnn_v1: parameter count, best validation macro F1, balanced accuracy, accuracy, per-class F1, confusion matrix, best epoch, training time
paired patient-bootstrap 95% CI of macro-F1 difference vs baseline_cnn_v3
device and sample-rate subgroups for analysis only (not for selection)
rules: no tuning after seeing validation results
test split never loaded or evaluated

pre_training_diagnostics.recorded: 2026-10-04, before the full run; protocol NOT changed
pre_training_diagnostics.padding_invariance: exact in float64 on real validation cycles (max diff 5.3e-16); float32 GPU diff up to 1.6e-3 from rounding, identical predictions
pre_training_diagnostics.tiny_overfit_32_train_cycles_lr_1e-3: train loss -> 0 and 100% accuracy with batch statistics and after BN running-stat recalibration; eval-mode accuracy with running statistics lagged (0.47-0.72) because BatchNorm momentum 0.01 (torchvision default) tracks rapidly changing activations slowly
pre_training_diagnostics.risk_noted: validation (running statistics) may lag training in early epochs; kept as predeclared (no change to momentum)
